import Mathlib

theorem p05 : ¬ ∃ q : ℚ, q * q = 2 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hq' : ((q : ℝ)) ^ 2 = 2 := by
    have h : ((q * q : ℚ) : ℝ) = ((2 : ℚ) : ℝ) := by rw [hq]
    push_cast at h
    rw [sq]
    exact h
  have h1 : Real.sqrt 2 = |(q : ℝ)| := by
    rw [← hq', Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  apply irrational_sqrt_two
  refine ⟨|q|, ?_⟩
  show ((|q| : ℚ) : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 2
  rw [h1]
  exact Rat.cast_abs q
